name: Sonobudoyo Museum
scope: The standing historic Unit I core across from the north square: the 1935 Thomas Karsten building, small receiving pavilion, main gate and rear gallery, western secretariat and 1941 range, along with the eastern Pendapa Kesenian and the frontage. Modern galleries, museum exhibits and Unit II are separate.
era: Standing historic Unit I museum, including the 1935 core and 1941 expansion.

originalReview.notes: Exact 2026 first-party CC0 original. Used the historic clay tile tiering and white masonry frontage. Did not reproduce the wording of the archival inscriptions, the panel art, modern decorative type or incidental elements.

review.notes: The public-domain CC0 photograph carried by Qualla was verified as the same original supplied and dedicated by photographer Zhou Guanhuai. Object photographs and copyrighted images were excluded.
